nodes.label: App Preview 03: Dashboard Screen
nodes.rationale: App Store marketing preview showing the main Monetic dashboard in dark mode: a monthly budget ring (remaining amount front and center) above a spending-by-group donut chart, communicating at-a-glance budget health.

nodes.label: Monetic Header Bar (Settings, Edit, Add)
nodes.rationale: Gradient MONETIC wordmark centered with a settings gear on the left and Edit plus a prominent blue + (add expense) button on the right; primary action is adding a transaction.

nodes.label: Monthly Budget Ring Card (Remaining / Spent / Budget)
nodes.rationale: Card for September 2026 with a circular progress ring showing $2,365.01 remaining (5% used), with Spent $134.99 and Budget $2,500.00 below; a filter/sliders button sits in the card corner. Emphasizes remaining budget over spent amount.

nodes.label: Spending Overview: By Group Donut Chart
nodes.rationale: Collapsible Spending Overview section with a segmented donut chart totaling $134.99 and a color-coded legend of category groups with amounts.

nodes.label: Expense Category Groups (Bills & Fees, Food & Dining, Health, Entertainment)
nodes.rationale: Sample data: Bills & Fees $89.00 (coral), Food & Dining $24.50 (amber), Health $12.50 (blue), Entertainment $8.99 (purple); groups roll up individual categories for overview charts.

nodes.label: Dark Navy-to-Purple Gradient Theme
nodes.rationale: Dark background gradient with rounded dark cards, letter-spaced uppercase section labels, and a blue-to-purple gradient wordmark; consistent visual language across the marketing previews.

hyperedges.label: Dashboard budget overview: budget ring, spending donut, and category groups
